        d2 = Dot(plane.n2p(-3 - 2j), color=YELLOW)
        label1 = MathTex("2+i").next_to(d1, UR, 0.1)
        label2 = MathTex("-3-2i").next_to(d2, UR, 0.1)

        plane = ComplexPlane().add_coordinates()

        d1 = Dot(plane.n2p(2 + 1j), color=YELLOW)
        d2 = Dot(plane.n2p(-3 - 2j), color=YELLOW)
